name: Bethel University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university in McKenzie, TN with ~3,000 students and a 15:1 student-to-faculty ratio. Offers 42 undergraduate and 5 graduate/professional programs across three colleges (Arts & Sciences, Health Sciences, and Professional Studies). Markets itself as one of the most affordable private Christian universities. No formal national ranking captured.
financial_aid: About 98% of students receive financial aid. 2026-27 full-time undergraduate tuition is $20,160/year ($10,080/semester); total estimated cost of attendance with residence hall ($6,480) and meal plan ($5,040) is roughly $31,680. Net Price Calculator and scholarship/aid pages available at bethelu.edu/sfs. As an NAIA program, athletic scholarships (softball NAIA limit is 10 equivalencies) are available but specific award counts not publicly listed.
facilities_notes: Softball is played at Lady Wildcat Park at the Kahlden Complex on the Bethel campus in McKenzie, TN (per bethelathletics.com/facilities).
program_reputation: NAIA women's softball program competing in the Mid-South Conference. Bethel University fields 21 NAIA sports teams. Roster is heavily Tennessee/regional based with several JUCO transfers.
notes: Data sourced live from bethelathletics.com on 2026-07. Coaches page (/sports/sball/coaches) lists only two softball staff: Head Coach Craig Massey and Assistant Coach Shanta Emerson. The 2026-27 roster page was not yet published; roster_size of 24 is from the published 2025-26 roster (/sports/sball/2025-26/roster). Tuition/academic data from bethelu.edu/sfs/cost.
